reports.title: Permian Resources Announces Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results and Updated Full Year Guidance

lines: •Raised mid-point of full year guidance for oil production to 202.5 MBbls/d and updated mid-point of capital expenditures guidance to $2.025 billion
Permian Resources increased its 2026 oil production target to 202.5 MBbls/d, based on the mid-point of guidance.
The Company’s updated full year oil guidance represents an increase of 13.5 MBbls/d compared to its initial oil guidance in February.
Through continued strong free cash flow generation, the Company expects to have less than 0.5x leverage1 at year-end 2026.
